articles.summary: Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) (the Company or Apple Hospitality) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a regular monthly cash distribution of $0.08 per common share. The distribution is payable on June 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 29, 2026. Based on the Companys common stock closing price of $14.09 on May 18, 2026, the annualized distribution of $0.96 per common share represents an annual yield of approximately 6.8%. About Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns one of the largest and most diverse portfolios of upscale, rooms-focused hotels in the United States. Apple Hospitalitys portfolio consists of 216 hotels with approximately 29,500 guest rooms located in 83 markets throughout 37 states and the District of Columbia.
